transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Um, I came in because... well, for the past few weeks, I’ve just felt this heavy, sad pressure sitting on me. It's there almost all day. Even when I’m at work—I'm a nurse, so I have to keep smiling at my patients—but inside, I just feel like I’m barely holding myself together.
Have you lost interest in or stopped enjoying activities that you usually like?

Yeah, I have. Usually, after my shifts, I used to paint, or I'd go to yoga or a salsa class to decompress. But lately... I just go straight home, sit on the couch, and ignore my texts. None of it really feels worth the effort anymore.
Have you had any thoughts of killing yourself or hurting yourself?

Well, I don't have a plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But... what actually scared me enough to finally say something, like at my prenatal appointment, was that I've been having these thoughts. Like... I just wish I wouldn't wake up.

{"intent":"Determine whether the depressive symptoms have lasted at least two weeks, supporting a major depressive episode rather than adjustment disorder.","question":"How long have you been feeling this way?""}
It's been about three weeks now. I think it started just... shortly after I found out I was pregnant.
How have these symptoms affected your ability to function at work and in your daily life?

I'm still making it to work, for now. But my supervisor has already noticed that my charting is incomplete, which really isn't like me. And outside of work... I've just been pulling away from my friends and all the routines that usually keep me steady. It's just getting really hard to keep up with everything.
How has your energy been over the past three weeks?

My energy? Um... I haven't really noticed a change there, to be honest. I guess it's been pretty normal. I mean, I'm not physically exhausted or anything... I just haven't really noticed an issue with my energy specifically.
How has your sleep been over the past three weeks?
My sleep has been... fine, really. I haven't noticed any changes with it. I'm still sleeping about the same as I usually do.
Over the past three weeks, have you been feeling unusually worthless or excessively guilty?

No, I wouldn't really say that. I mean, I don't feel great about falling behind on my charting at work, but I don't feel worthless or excessively guilty about things. I just haven't really had those specific feelings.
Have you been having trouble concentrating lately?

Yes, actually. That's been a real issue for me. Um, I keep having to reread medication orders and wound-care notes at work because my brain just feels really foggy. And decisions I normally make automatically... I just kind of freeze up now and second-guess myself.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite over the past three weeks?

Yeah, my appetite has definitely decreased. I know I should be eating regularly, but... most days food just sounds really unappealing to me right now. I'll actually realize halfway through a clinic shift that I’ve only had some crackers or maybe just coffee all day.
Have you noticed feeling unusually restless or unable to sit still lately?
No, not really. Um, I haven't noticed feeling restless or having any trouble sitting still. I can sit just fine.

Difficulty concentrating, rereading work materials, and second-guessing routine decisions
